summary: Add the Russian Post Otpravka connector as a separate Delivery surface with encrypted application-token/user-key enrollment and a bounded official settings health probe; shipment operations remain qualification-gated.

impacts.evidence: Russian Post credentials are bound to one tenant-scoped Connector SDK account; no caller-supplied tenant override is accepted.
The application token and generated user authorization key stay behind SecretProvider; the bounded health probe does not persist provider payloads or recipient data.
No public REST/OpenAPI operation is added; the existing connector-account control plane is reused for setup and health checks.
No event or canonical envelope is added.
The adapter uses the frozen Connector SDK v1 and existing logistics capability declarations without changing SDK ports.
No provider-specific table or migration is introduced; generic connector account, secret and health history storage is reused.

The host performs TLS-verified requests only to the fixed public Otpravka API host and keeps both credential values callback-scoped; strict JSON decoding rejects malformed or unknown credential fields.
Shipment creation and other write-sensitive logistics capabilities are not admitted to application callers; future admission must pass capability and approval policy.
Credential health checks use the existing connector.account.connection_checked audit event and retain only safe health metadata.
The manifest and SDK boundary retain canonical logistics idempotency fields, while no scheduler or remote write retry is enabled before carrier qualification.
The current surface performs one fixed outbound settings probe; no arbitrary callback URL or webhook ingress is added.
Manifest timeout/retry metadata, bounded responses and normalized provider-unavailable health state constrain the remote probe.
The separate-surface entry can be disabled through existing account/runtime support controls without a schema rollback.

Deterministic provider, host transport and SDK conformance tests cover the secret boundary, malformed credentials, tenant isolation, idempotency, egress and sandbox behavior without production credentials.
